history.summary: A local Jagannath shrine on the Fatikroy–Manu road near Kumarghat; no published history found. Identity is provisional: the CSV name is generic and no dedicated web record exists for this temple. Coordinates match a 'Jagannath Temple' POI on Fatikroy–Manu Rd (~8–10 km south of Kumarghat town); a separate 'Jagganath Bari Temple' is listed at Pabiachhara part near Kumarghat, which may be a different shrine.

name: Jagannath Temple
town_description: Kumarghat is a town and subdivision headquarters in Unakoti district, northern Tripura, on the Lumding–Sabroom railway line and NH-8. It is the railhead for the famous Unakoti rock-cut archaeological site, about 29 km away, and a market town for the surrounding area.

travel.airport: Maharaja Bir Bikram Airport, Agartala (~200 km by road)
travel.road: Fatikroy–Manu Road; NH-8 runs through Kumarghat

visitor_information.opening_hours: Unpublished (verify); local temples generally open dawn to dusk
